column3: lispi uses unit Lisp, which uses the collection's unit BoehmGC: boehmgc.pas line 12 binds GCMalloc to libgc's GC_malloc (cdecl; external 'libgc'), and its initialization (line 126) installs a TMemoryManager of routines over it by SetMemoryManager, so every heap block of the interpreter is a libgc block reached by raw pointer arithmetic (Dec(P, SizeOf(PtrInt)), PPtrInt(P)^); SCRIP has no external directive and no memory-manager hook, and a stand-in cannot exist under its (base cell, index) pointers (R5).
